pr.title: Arcade multi-game centre + rebrand
pr.body:
## Summary
- Rebrand **temp-battle → arcade** (packages, UI, streams, deploy paths, remote)
- Multi-game centre: tic-tac-toe, connect four, RPS
- Clean-architecture API under `apps/api`, engines in `packages/`
- Shared login, scoreboard, admin insights (`admin` / `admin`)
- OpenObserve streams: `arcade_logs`, `arcade_traces`, `arcade_*` metrics

## Test plan
- [ ] `bun start` → http://localhost:3000 shows **arcade**
- [ ] Play all three games
- [ ] Admin insights load
- [ ] `/api/observability/verify` → ok with arcade streams
- [ ] Deploy to EC2 uses `~/arcade` and image `arcade-app:prod`


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)

commitMessage:

Rename the product, packages, OpenObserve streams, and deploy paths from temp-battle to arcade, and ship the pluggable game engines with shared auth, scoreboard, and admin insights.
